question: Can Yggdrasil's same native cumulative learner and previously trained transition/reward specialists continue, while new independently trainable temporal-history JEPA-style experts learn from new genuinely witnessed causal trajectories and improve action-consequence prediction under shift without damaging old memories?

prior.result: DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO: 0.9? prior 0.75 native/0.25 JEPA blend degraded native on 2/2 sources; original retained checkpoints have independently verified cold training
prior.avoid: Do not tune/replay scored old 14071/14072 checkpoints for gains. Old source used ONLY as frozen initial model to be continued.

source.generator: unchanged research/contrib/chatgpt/CKAD-37/campaign.py generator; evaluator-only regime and phase. Actual public observations supplied only to original NativeEpisodeExperience.observe.

architecture.model: one opt-in persistent NativeTemporalMultiLearner wrapping unchanged NativeMultiLearner v1 + two independently fitted temporal latent experts
architecture.continues_old: original native memory and both previous trained specialist weights retained and continued without any reset, no new controller
architecture.temporal_features: current public paired views, action inputs, previous 8 witnessed action/consequence histories and relative positions, no future/hidden regime/oracle label
architecture.teacher: 2D noncollapsed fixed stop-gradient binary code, action-conditioned latent prediction of next state or actually observed terminal outcome
architecture.prediction_order: native/one-step/temporal predictions are made before witnessed outcome; then update original native + 2 old experts + 2 temporal experts
architecture.readout: conservative frozen 90% native + 10% temporal; temporal-only separately tracked
architecture.checkpoint: cold persistent old and new weights with source-ledger refit verification, checksum-bound native source, duplicate and conflict atomic

train.warm_start: fit new temporal experts by replaying old observed native ledger; keep existing old native and learned old specialists exactly untouched until new episodes arrive
train.source_order: each seed starts from CKAD37 prior world0 full source; append new dev world0 and dev world1 sequentially to SAME cumulative learner

comparators: original continued native stream, same sources and actions
original one-step JEPA2-02 continued specialists, same sources
independent fully fitted causal-cell Beta full-history, window24, window48 and discount95, initialized on old recorded observations
same-size temporal specialist training using previous unrelated outcomes as mispair negative with matched updates

score.primary: pooled prequential transition/terminal Brier on new late_B and late_return_A source events, each outcome scored before actual observation
secondary: stable_A, early_B, late_B, early_return_A and late_return_A by seed, both worlds
old native source prefix/legacy learned weights retention
cold restore exact rederived temporal and previous learned weights
source IDs and conflict duplicate atomicity
CPU/wall and full training step counts
score.frozen_development_go: BOTH seeds: blend pooled late Brier at least .005 below continued native and at least .010 below best independently fitted Beta; temporal-only at least .010 below mispaired temporal; early_B and late_return_A blend no worse native by .010; source and old state intact. Else DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO with no tuning/repeat on scored seeds.
score.science: SCIENTIFIC_PASS always false; these are new synthetic development experiences from already-known generator, not independent first-use or real-world causal transfer.
